dub_home_orla.text: Come in, come in. 'Grand' means everything from 'fine' to 'wonderful'. A 'yoke' is any gadget whose name you have forgotten.
Dublin's Georgian doors are famously bright. One story is that people painted them to tell the identical houses apart.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: Down in the Park the fawnlets hide in the bracken. Walk quietly, and they might not hide. Here, some barmbrack, my gran's recipe.

then.text: Back for the Dublin Coddle? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: A coddle is only any good if you've nowhere to be. Pull up a chair.
Layer it all in a pot, cover with water, and leave it on a low heat till the sausages go pale. Grey? Yes. Gorgeous? Also yes.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
